english.note: This is the all-purpose casual choice for making an error or incorrect thing right.

examples.english: I’ll correct this sentence for you.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 bong1 nei5 goi2 faan1 ni1 geoi3

english.note: Use this as the everyday choice when modifying something so that it fits a purpose or preference.
Use 改 as the all-purpose spoken verb when changing part of something.
Use 改 as the all-purpose verb for deliberately changing a form, structure, plan, or arrangement.
Use this when someone deliberately changes or alters something, including changing it to introduce variety.
Use this when someone deliberately makes or alters something into a different form.

examples.english: I want to adjust the time a little so it is more convenient for everyone.
examples.traditional: 我想改吓個時間，等大家方便啲。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 goi2 haa5 go3 si4 gaan3 dang2 daai6 gaa1 fong1 bin6 di1

examples.english: I want to modify these trousers to make them shorter first.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 goi2 dyun2 tiu4 fu3 sin1

examples.english: We need to alter the plan.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 goi2 go3 gai3 waak6

examples.english: You can vary the recipe to make the flavour different.
examples.traditional: 你可以改下食譜，等個味道唔同啲。
examples.jyutping: nei5 ho2 ji5 goi2 haa5 sik6 pou2 dang2 go3 mei6 dou6 m4 tung4 di1

examples.english: I want to change the design.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 goi2 go3 cit3 gai3
